scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs && node scripts/isolated-agent.mjs npm run test --workspaces
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w pi-claude-style && npm run build -w pi-subagents && npm run build -w pi-processes && npm run build -w @narumitw/pi-goal && npm run build -w pi-mcp-adapter && node scripts/isolated-agent.mjs node --import ./ts-resolve.mjs --experimental-strip-types --test integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:side-chat: npm run build -w pi-claude-style && node scripts/isolated-agent.mjs bun integration/side-chat/sdk-view-e2e.mjs && PI_S2_NATIVE_PRESENTATION=1 node scripts/isolated-agent.mjs bun integration/side-chat/sdk-view-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:integration:stock-host: npm run build -w pi-subagents && bun integration/subagent-no-presentation.mjs
scripts.test:integration:subagents: npm run build -w pi-subagents && node integration/run-subagents.mjs
scripts.check:goal: node scripts/isolated-agent.mjs npm --prefix fork/pi-goal run check
scripts.test:integration:goal-ui: npm run build -w @narumitw/pi-goal && npm run build -w pi-claude-style && node scripts/isolated-agent.mjs bun integration/goal/ui-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:integration:mcp: npm run build -w pi-claude-style && npm run build -w @narumitw/pi-goal && npm run build -w pi-mcp-adapter && node scripts/isolated-agent.mjs node --import ./ts-resolve.mjs --experimental-strip-types --test integration/mcp*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:search: npm run build -w pi-claude-style && npm run build -w pi-subagents && node scripts/isolated-agent.mjs node --import ./ts-resolve.mjs --experimental-strip-types --test integration/search*.test.ts
scripts.test:integration:ask: npm run build -w pi-claude-style && node scripts/isolated-agent.mjs node --import ./ts-resolve.mjs --experimental-strip-types --test integration/ask*.test.ts
